summary.en: Holds the plant firmly in the soil.
summary.zh: 把植株牢牢固定在土里。

detail.en:
A thick root that grows straight down from the base of the stem. Side roots branch off it, and with them it holds the plant upright in the soil [S2].

In the model it reaches almost to the bottom of an 18 cm pot [S1]. Stem and root meet at the soil line; above it the tissue is green, below it pale.
detail.zh:
从茎基部笔直向下长的一条粗根。侧根从它分出，和它一起把植株稳稳地立在土里 [S2]。

模型里它几乎伸到 18 厘米深的花盆底部 [S1]。茎和根在土面相接：土面以上是绿色的，以下是浅色的。

summary.en: Spread out through the soil and grip more of it.
summary.zh: 向四周伸展，抓住更多的土。

detail.en:
Side roots branch from the main root and spread out through the soil, each branching again. Together they grip a large volume of soil and reach water that the main root alone would miss [S2].

The model draws twelve side roots, each with one branch; a real root system has many more, finer branches.
detail.zh:
侧根从主根上分出，向四周伸进土里，还会再分枝。它们一起抓住一大团土，也能吸到光靠主根够不着的水 [S2]。

模型画了 12 条侧根，每条带一个分枝；真实的根系分枝更多、更细。

summary.en: Take in water and mineral salts through root hairs.
summary.zh: 用根毛吸收水和矿物盐。

detail.en:
The thinnest roots, near their growing tips, are covered with root hairs. Root hairs are long, thin outgrowths of the outer cells, and they give the root a much larger surface through which water and the mineral salts dissolved in it are taken in [S2, S8].

The water then moves into the larger roots and up the stem in the water-carrying tubes [S3].

Root hairs are delicate. When a plant is pulled up and replanted, many are torn off, so for a few days it takes in less water and may droop.
detail.zh:
最细的根靠近生长尖端的地方长满根毛。根毛是外层细胞长出的细长突起，让根吸收水和溶在水里的矿物盐的表面大了很多 [S2, S8]。

水随后进入较粗的根，再沿着输水管往茎上走 [S3]。

根毛很娇嫩。把植株拔起来再种下，很多根毛会被扯断，所以之后几天它吸进的水变少，叶子可能会垂下来。

summary.en: Holds the plant up and links roots to leaves.
summary.zh: 撑起植株，连接根和叶。

detail.en:
The stem holds up the leaves, flowers and fruit, and links them to the roots [S3]. Inside it run the water-carrying tubes and the food-carrying tubes.

In the model it is about 1.3 cm thick at the base and forks about 18 cm above the soil [S1]; chilli stems branch in pairs, again and again [S11]. The slight rings mark the nodes, where leaves grow.

A stem bent or cracked across cuts both kinds of tube: the leaves above wilt, and the roots below get less sugar.
detail.zh:
茎撑起叶、花和果实，把它们和根连起来 [S3]。茎里面有输水管和输食管。

模型里茎基部粗约 1.3 厘米，在土面以上约 18 厘米处分叉 [S1]；辣椒的茎一再成对分叉 [S11]。茎上浅浅的环是节，叶子长在节上。

茎被折断或横向裂开，两种管都会断掉：上面的叶子会萎蔫，下面的根得到的糖也会变少。

summary.en: Hold leaves and flowers up towards the light.
summary.zh: 把叶和花托向光。

detail.en:
Above the first fork the stem splits in two, and each half splits again. Chilli stems branch this way, in pairs [S11], which gives the plant its bushy, rounded shape and spreads the leaves out to the light.

The model forks three times, ending in eight tips with young leaves and buds; a flower or a fruit hangs at many of the forks [S10].
detail.zh:
在第一个分叉以上，茎一分为二，每一半再一分为二。辣椒的茎就是这样成对分枝的 [S11]，所以株形圆而茂密，叶子也向四周伸到光里。

模型分叉三次，末端是 8 个长着嫩叶和花蕾的枝梢；很多分叉处挂着一朵花或一个果 [S10]。

summary.en: Join each leaf blade to the stem.
summary.zh: 把叶片连到茎上。

detail.en:
Each leaf blade is joined to the stem by a stalk. The water-carrying and food-carrying tubes run through it into the leaf veins and back [S3].

The model's stalks are 2–3 cm long; Flora of China gives 4–7 cm for chilli [S10], and potted plants are often more compact.
detail.zh:
每片叶片都靠一根叶柄连在茎上。输水管和输食管经过叶柄，通到叶脉里，也从叶脉通回来 [S3]。

模型里叶柄长 2–3 厘米；《中国植物志》给辣椒的叶柄长 4–7 厘米 [S10]，盆栽的植株往往更紧凑。

summary.en: Carry water and mineral salts up from the roots.
summary.zh: 把水和矿物盐从根往上送。

detail.en:
Water-carrying tubes take water and the mineral salts dissolved in it from the roots up to the leaves, flowers and fruit. Water moves through them only upwards [S3, S5].

The tubes are made of cells that are dead when they work: their ends and contents are gone, leaving hollow pipes. Scientists call them xylem [S3]. The model draws eight thick tubes round the centre; a real stem has many thousands of thin ones.

Stand a cut stem in coloured water and these are the tubes that take up the colour.
detail.zh:
输水管把水和溶在水里的矿物盐从根送到叶、花和果实。水在输水管里只向上走 [S3, S5]。

输水管由已经死去的细胞连成：细胞的两端和里面的东西都没有了，只剩中空的管子。科学家把它们叫作木质部 [S3]。模型画了绕着中心的 8 条粗管，真实的茎里有成千上万条细管。

把切下的枝条插在有颜色的水里，被染色的就是这些管子。

summary.en: Carry sugar made in the leaves to other parts.
summary.zh: 把叶子造的糖送到植物各处。

detail.en:
Food-carrying tubes take sugar made in the leaves to every part that needs it: down to the roots, and to new shoots, flowers and growing fruit. Unlike water, sugar can travel both up and down [S5].

These tubes are made of living cells joined end to end; scientists call them phloem [S3]. Sugar travels in them mostly as sucrose [S5]. In the model they are the thinner ochre tubes outside the water-carrying ones.

If a ring of bark is cut away all round a stem, these tubes are cut and sugar no longer reaches the roots [S26].
detail.zh:
输食管把叶子造的糖送到需要它的每个部分：向下送到根，也送到新芽、花和正在长大的果实。和水不同，糖可以向上走，也可以向下走 [S5]。

输食管由首尾相连的活细胞组成，科学家把它们叫作韧皮部 [S3]。糖在输食管里主要以蔗糖的形式运输 [S5]。模型里它们是输水管外侧较细的赭黄色管。

如果把茎外面的树皮环剥一圈，这些管就被切断，糖再也送不到根 [S26]。

summary.en: Make most of the plant's food, using light.
summary.zh: 利用光制造植物的大部分食物。

detail.en:
The older, darker leaves make most of the plant's food. Their green parts use light, water and carbon dioxide to make sugar and give out oxygen [S6].

Chilli leaves are oval to lance-shaped with a smooth edge, 4–13 cm long [S10, S12]; the model's are 7.5–9.5 cm [S1]. A main vein runs down the middle and side veins branch from it; the curved leaves in the model have a fold along the main vein.
detail.zh:
颜色较深的老叶制造了植物大部分的食物。叶子的绿色部分利用光、水和二氧化碳制造糖，并放出氧 [S6]。

辣椒叶呈椭圆形到披针形，边缘光滑，长 4–13 厘米 [S10, S12]；模型里的长 7.5–9.5 厘米 [S1]。中间一条主脉，两侧分出侧脉；模型中弯曲的叶片沿主脉有一道折痕。

summary.en: Grow at the tips of the branches, then make food too.
summary.zh: 长在枝梢，长大后也制造食物。

detail.en:
New leaves open at the tips of the branches. They are paler and thinner at first, and they make food as soon as they are green [S6].

The model's young leaves are 4.5–6 cm long [S1] and stand more upright than the older ones.
detail.zh:
新叶在枝梢展开。起初颜色浅、叶片薄，一变绿就开始制造食物 [S6]。

模型里的嫩叶长 4.5–6 厘米 [S1]，比老叶更向上挺立。

summary.en: Flowers that have not opened yet.
summary.zh: 还没有开放的花。

detail.en:
Flowers that have not yet opened. The green sepals are wrapped round the petals inside [S10].

In the model three buds hang at branch tips, above the open flowers and the fruit, so the plant shows every stage at once.
detail.zh:
还没有开放的花，绿色的花萼包着里面的花瓣 [S10]。

模型里 3 个花蕾挂在枝梢，位置比开着的花和果实高，所以同一株上能看到每个阶段。

summary.en: Open petals; visiting insects carry pollen.
summary.zh: 张开的花瓣；来访的昆虫带来花粉。

detail.en:
The flower is the part that makes seeds. A chilli flower is white, about 1 cm across, and usually hangs alone below a fork in the stem [S10, S12]. It has 5 petals, sometimes 6 or 7 [S11].

The model draws its three open flowers larger than life, about 1.7 cm across, so they can be seen at plant scale [S1]. White petals and nectar attract insects such as bees [S12].

Chilli flowers can pollinate themselves, but bee visits give more and better fruit [S13, S14].
detail.zh:
花是产生种子的部分。辣椒花白色，宽约 1 厘米，通常单独一朵垂在茎的分叉下面 [S10, S12]，有 5 片花瓣，偶尔 6 或 7 片 [S11]。

为了在整株的尺度上看得清，模型把 3 朵开着的花画得比实物大，宽约 1.7 厘米 [S1]。白色的花瓣和花蜜吸引蜜蜂等昆虫 [S12]。

辣椒花自己就能完成传粉，但有蜜蜂来访，结的果更多、更好 [S13, S14]。

summary.en: Protected the flower bud before it opened.
summary.zh: 花开以前包住、保护花蕾。

detail.en:
The green cup at the base of each flower. Before the flower opens, the sepals wrap and protect the bud; afterwards they stay on and become the green cap of the fruit [S10].

The flower stalk bends near its tip, which is why chilli flowers usually hang facing down or sideways [S10].
detail.zh:
每朵花基部的绿色小杯。花开以前，花萼包住并保护花蕾；花开以后它留下来，成为果实顶上的绿色小帽 [S10]。

花梗靠近顶端的地方弯曲，所以辣椒花通常朝下或朝侧面垂着 [S10]。

summary.en: The anthers make pollen.
summary.zh: 花药产生花粉。

detail.en:
The male parts of the flower. Each stamen is a thin stalk, the filament, carrying an anther, which makes pollen. Chilli anthers are purplish, about 2 mm long [S10]; a flower has 5 stamens, sometimes up to 7 [S11].

The model gives the front flower five stamens round the pistil, and the two other open flowers a simple ring of anthers.

NParks describes chilli as buzz-pollinated by bees, and notes that it gives the most fruit when bees are around [S13].
detail.zh:
雄蕊是花的雄性部分。每枚雄蕊由细细的花丝托着一个花药，花药产生花粉。辣椒的花药带紫色，长约 2 毫米 [S10]；一朵花有 5 枚雄蕊，最多 7 枚 [S11]。

模型里前面那朵花的 5 枚雄蕊围着雌蕊，另外两朵开着的花只画成一圈花药。

NParks 说辣椒靠蜜蜂振动传粉，有蜜蜂来访时结果最多 [S13]。

summary.en: Receives pollen; its ovary holds the ovules.
summary.zh: 接住花粉；子房里有胚珠。

detail.en:
The female part of the flower, in the centre: a sticky stigma on top that catches pollen, a slender style, and the ovary at the base with the ovules inside [S7].

The chilli ovary has two, sometimes three, chambers [S10]. After fertilisation the ovules become seeds and the ovary becomes the fruit [S7].

If no pollen reaches the stigma, the ovules are not fertilised and the flower usually drops without making a fruit.
detail.zh:
雌蕊是花中央的雌性部分：顶上是黏黏的柱头，接住花粉；中间是细长的花柱；基部是子房，里面有胚珠 [S7]。

辣椒的子房有两室，有时三室 [S10]。受精以后，胚珠发育成种子，子房发育成果实 [S7]。

如果没有花粉落到柱头上，胚珠就不能受精，花通常会掉落，结不成果。

summary.en: Growing fruit, formed from the ovary.
summary.zh: 正在长大的果实，由子房发育而来。

detail.en:
Growing fruit. After fertilisation the ovary swells into a berry, green while it grows [S7, S10].

The model's fruits are 5.5–6 cm long [S1]; chilli fruits vary widely, up to 15 cm [S10]. Sugar for the growing fruit and seeds comes down the food-carrying tubes from the leaves [S5].

Green fruit can be eaten, but its seeds are not ready to grow yet.
detail.zh:
正在长大的果实。受精以后，子房膨大成浆果，长大的时候是绿色的 [S7, S10]。

模型里的果长 5.5–6 厘米 [S1]；辣椒果实的大小差别很大，长可达 15 厘米 [S10]。果实和种子长大所需的糖，由输食管从叶子送来 [S5]。

青果可以吃，但里面的种子还不能发芽。

summary.en: Ripe fruit with the seeds inside.
summary.zh: 成熟的果实，里面有种子。

detail.en:
A ripe fruit. Most chilli fruits turn red when ripe, though some varieties ripen orange, yellow or purple [S10]. The seeds inside are then mature: in a study of sweet pepper this happened about 75 days after the flower opened [S28].

A ripe chilli holds many pale, flat seeds, often more than twenty [S12].

Ripe red fruits are eaten by birds, which spread the seeds (chapter 6).
detail.zh:
成熟的果实。大多数辣椒成熟时变红，也有些品种成熟时是橙色、黄色或紫色 [S10]。这时里面的种子已经成熟：一项对甜椒的研究中，这大约是开花后 75 天 [S28]。

一只成熟的辣椒里有很多扁平的浅色种子，常常超过 20 粒 [S12]。

成熟的红果会被鸟吃掉，鸟把种子带到别处（第 6 章）。

summary.en: Visits flowers and carries pollen between them.
summary.zh: 访花，把花粉从一朵花带到另一朵。

detail.en:
A bee visiting the flowers; it is not part of the plant. Hairs on its body pick up pollen, which rubs off on the stigma of the next flower it visits [S7].

NParks notes that chilli is pollinated by bees and gives the most fruit when bees are around [S13]. The model's bee is about 1 cm long.

The model's animation is slowed and simplified: the bee moves from one flower to another in a few seconds.
detail.zh:
一只来访的蜜蜂，它不是植物的一部分。蜜蜂身上的毛沾上花粉，再访下一朵花时，花粉就蹭到那朵花的柱头上 [S7]。

NParks 指出，辣椒靠蜜蜂传粉，有蜜蜂来访时结果最多 [S13]。模型里的蜜蜂长约 1 厘米。

模型的动画是放慢、简化过的：蜜蜂几秒钟就从一朵花飞到另一朵。

summary.en: Inside a leaf: where the food is made.
summary.zh: 叶子的里面：造食物的地方。

detail.en:
A block cut from a leaf and drawn about 250 times larger [S1]. On top is a thin skin; under it a row of column-shaped cells packed tightly together; below them loosely packed cells with air spaces between them; then the lower skin, with tiny openings [S4].

Both kinds of inner cell are green with chlorophyll, and this is where light, water and carbon dioxide are made into sugar and oxygen [S4, S6]. The model draws far fewer, larger cells than a real leaf has.

The air spaces let carbon dioxide reach every green cell from the openings.
detail.zh:
从叶子上切下的一小块，放大约 250 倍 [S1]。最上面是薄薄的表皮；下面是一排紧挨着的柱子形细胞；再下面是排得松散、细胞之间有空隙的细胞；最下面是下表皮，上面有小孔 [S4]。

两种内部细胞都含绿色的叶绿素，光、水和二氧化碳就在这里变成糖和氧 [S4, S6]。模型画的细胞比真实叶子里的少得多，也大得多。

细胞之间的空隙让二氧化碳从小孔进来后能到达每一个绿色细胞。

summary.en: Both kinds of tube run through every vein.
summary.zh: 每条叶脉里都有两种管。

detail.en:
A vein cut across, at the same scale as the leaf block. It holds both kinds of tube: in the model the water-carrying tubes are drawn in the upper half and the food-carrying tubes in the lower half [S8].

Water arrives through the vein and spreads to the green cells; sugar made in them leaves through the vein towards the stem [S5].

The syllabus does not ask where the two kinds of tube lie; the model only draws them as they are.
detail.zh:
横切的一条叶脉，与叶片切块同样放大。叶脉里两种管都有：模型把输水管画在上半部，输食管画在下半部 [S8]。

水经叶脉送来，散到绿色细胞里；细胞造的糖再经叶脉送往茎 [S5]。

课纲不要求记住两种管的位置，模型只是照实画出来。

summary.en: Lets carbon dioxide in, oxygen and water vapour out.
summary.zh: 让二氧化碳进来，氧和水蒸气出去。

detail.en:
One of the tiny openings in the leaf, between two bean-shaped guard cells. Carbon dioxide comes in through it and oxygen goes out; water vapour also escapes through it [S4, S5]. Scientists call these openings stomata.

On most leaves they are mainly on the underside [S4]. The guard cells open the stoma in light and close it at night [S5]; the model's gentle pulse stands for this, much faster than in life. Beside the leaf block the model also draws the opening larger than a real one would be at the same magnification, so that its two guard cells can be seen.

With its openings closed a leaf loses little water, but it also takes in little carbon dioxide.
detail.zh:
叶上的一个小孔，夹在两个豆子形的保卫细胞之间。二氧化碳从这里进来，氧从这里出去，水蒸气也从这里散失 [S4, S5]。科学家把这些小孔叫作气孔。

多数叶子的小孔主要在叶背 [S4]。保卫细胞在有光时把小孔打开、夜里关上 [S5]；模型里轻微的开合代表这一点，比真实的快得多。放在叶片切块旁边的这个小孔，也比同样放大倍数下的真实小孔画得大，这样才能看清两个保卫细胞。

小孔关着时，叶子散失的水少了，吸进的二氧化碳也少了。

summary.en: A slice across the stem shows the bundles of tubes.
summary.zh: 茎的横切面上可以看到一束束管子。

detail.en:
A thin slice across the stem, drawn 8 times larger [S1]. From the outside in: a skin, a band of green tissue, a ring of bundles of tubes, and soft pale tissue in the centre [S3].

In each bundle the water-carrying tubes face the centre and the food-carrying tubes face outwards [S3]. The model draws seven bundles; a real stem has more.

This is the slice you see when you cut across a stem that has stood in coloured water: the stained dots are the bundles.
detail.zh:
茎的横切薄片，放大 8 倍 [S1]。从外到内：表皮、一圈绿色组织、排成一圈的维管束、中央柔软的浅色组织 [S3]。

每一束里，输水管朝向中心，输食管朝外 [S3]。模型画了 7 束；真实的茎里更多。

把插过有色水的枝条横着切开，看到的就是这样的切面：被染色的小点就是这些维管束。

summary.en: Root hairs reach between the soil grains.
summary.zh: 根毛伸进土粒之间。

detail.en:
The tip of a fine root, drawn about 30 times larger [S1]. Behind the tip, outer cells grow out into long, thin root hairs that reach between soil grains [S2].

Root hairs greatly increase the surface through which water and mineral salts are taken in [S2, S8]. The model draws fifteen; a real root tip carries many hundreds.

The very tip is covered by a cap, which protects it as it pushes through the soil [S2].
detail.zh:
一条细根的尖端，放大约 30 倍 [S1]。尖端后面，外层细胞长成细长的根毛，伸进土粒之间 [S2]。

根毛大大增加了吸收水和矿物盐的表面 [S2, S8]。模型画了 15 根，真实的根尖上有成百上千根。

根最尖端有根冠，在根向土里钻的时候保护它 [S2]。

summary.en: The stamens stand round the pistil.
summary.zh: 雄蕊围着雌蕊。

detail.en:
A flower cut in half lengthwise and drawn 6 times larger [S1]; the two halves open like a book. In the middle is the pistil: stigma, style and ovary, with the ovules inside the ovary. Around it stand the stamens with their purple anthers [S7, S10].

The model shows three of the five petals and two of the five stamens in each half.

Cutting a flower in half with a craft knife, under a teacher's eye, shows the same parts.
detail.zh:
一朵纵向剖开、放大 6 倍的花 [S1]，两半像书一样打开。中间是雌蕊：柱头、花柱和子房，子房里有胚珠；四周是带紫色花药的雄蕊 [S7, S10]。

模型每一半画出 5 片花瓣中的 3 片、5 枚雄蕊中的 2 枚。

在老师指导下用美工刀把一朵花切成两半，也能看到同样的部分。

summary.en: Become seeds after fertilisation.
summary.zh: 受精以后发育成种子。

detail.en:
The small round bodies inside the ovary. Each contains a female reproductive cell [S7].

When a male reproductive cell from a pollen grain joins it, the ovule is fertilised and grows into a seed [S7, S29].

A ripe chilli has many seeds because the ovary has many ovules.
detail.zh:
子房里的小圆粒，每个里面有一个雌性生殖细胞 [S7]。

花粉粒带来的雄性生殖细胞与它融合，胚珠就受精了，之后发育成种子 [S7, S29]。

成熟的辣椒里有很多种子，是因为子房里有很多胚珠。

summary.en: Each grain carries a male reproductive cell.
summary.zh: 每粒花粉里有雄性生殖细胞。

detail.en:
Pollen grains from the anthers, greatly magnified. Each grain carries a male reproductive cell [S7].

The model draws them as round grains with three long grooves. It shows fewer grains than a real anther holds.

Pollen is carried from flower to flower on the hairy bodies of bees [S7].
detail.zh:
从花药里出来的花粉粒，放大了很多倍。每一粒都带着雄性生殖细胞 [S7]。

模型把它们画成带三条长沟的圆形颗粒，数量比真实花药里的少。

花粉靠蜜蜂多毛的身体从一朵花带到另一朵 [S7]。

summary.en: Inside: seed coat, two seed leaves and a tiny plant.
summary.zh: 里面有种皮、两片子叶和小小的胚。

detail.en:
A green bean (mung bean) seed, not a chilli seed, split open and drawn 10 times life size [S1]. Inside the seed coat are two seed leaves full of stored food, and a tiny plant with a root tip and a shoot tip [S7].

A bean is used because its large seed leaves are easy to see; chilli seeds are flat and only 3–5 mm across [S10].

Beans store the food for germination in their seed leaves [S7].
detail.zh:
一粒绿豆的种子，不是辣椒籽，剖开并放大 10 倍 [S1]。种皮里面是两片储满养分的子叶，以及一个带着胚根和胚芽的小小的胚 [S7]。

用绿豆，是因为它的子叶大，容易看清；辣椒籽扁平，只有 3–5 毫米宽 [S10]。

豆类把萌发所需的养分储存在子叶里 [S7]。

summary.en: After taking in water, the root comes out first.
summary.zh: 吸水以后，胚根先长出来。

detail.en:
The same kind of seed after taking in water, drawn 5 times life size [S1]. It has swollen, the seed coat has split, and the root has come out first, growing downwards.

A seed needs water, air and a suitable temperature to germinate [S20]. Mung bean sprouts are ready to eat 3 to 7 days after soaking [S21].

A seed kept under water with little air may fail to germinate [S20].
detail.zh:
同一种种子吸水以后，放大 5 倍 [S1]。它胀大了，种皮裂开，胚根先长出来，向下生长。

种子萌发需要水、空气和适宜的温度 [S20]。绿豆浸泡后 3 到 7 天，豆芽就可以吃了 [S21]。

种子泡在水里、空气太少，就可能不萌发 [S20]。

summary.en: The shoot lifts the seed leaves into the light.
summary.zh: 幼茎把子叶举到光里。

detail.en:
A young bean plant, drawn 1.5 times life size [S1]. The shoot has lifted the two seed leaves above the soil, which is how mung beans germinate [S21], and the first true leaves are opening between them.

The seed leaves feed the seedling with their stored food until the true leaves can make food [S7].
detail.zh:
一株绿豆幼苗，放大 1.5 倍 [S1]。幼茎把两片子叶举出土面，绿豆就是这样出土萌发的 [S21]；子叶之间，第一对真叶正在展开。

在真叶能自己造食物以前，子叶用储存的养分喂养幼苗 [S7]。

summary.en: A young chilli plant with its first true leaves.
summary.zh: 长出第一对真叶的辣椒幼苗。

detail.en:
A chilli seedling, a young plant, drawn 1.5 times life size [S1]. Its two seed leaves are long and narrow; the first true leaves are broader, with the shape of the adult leaves.

Chilli seeds come up in about one to three weeks [S12, S13]: in one set of measurements, about 8 days in soil at 25 °C [S22].

NParks advises at least 6 hours of direct sunlight a day for chilli [S13].
detail.zh:
一株辣椒幼苗，也就是幼株，放大 1.5 倍 [S1]。两片子叶又长又窄；第一对真叶宽一些，形状已经和成株的叶子相似。

辣椒种子大约一到三周出苗 [S12, S13]：一组测量中，在 25℃ 的土里约 8 天 [S22]。

NParks 建议辣椒每天至少有 6 小时直射阳光 [S13]。

summary.en: Wind: the flat wing lets the fruit drift away.
summary.zh: 风：扁平的翅让果实飘远。

detail.en:
The fruit of the angsana, a tree commonly planted along Singapore's roads [S16]. It is a flat disc 3–5 cm across: a papery wing round a seed-bearing centre. The wind carries it away from the tree [S16].

The model draws it 1.5 times life size [S1].

The wing is a structure that helps dispersal: it makes the fruit fall slowly, so a breeze can carry it further. Structures like this are adaptations for dispersal [S29].
detail.zh:
青龙木的果实，这种树常种在新加坡的路边 [S16]。果实是直径 3–5 厘米的扁圆盘：中央带种子，四周是一圈纸一样的薄翅，风把它带离母树 [S16]。

模型把它画成实物的 1.5 倍 [S1]。

翅是帮助传播的结构：它让果实落得慢，微风就能把它带得更远。这样的结构是帮助传播的适应 [S29]。

summary.en: Water: air in the fibrous husk lets it float.
summary.zh: 水：纤维层里有空气，能漂浮。

detail.en:
A coconut, drawn at about 0.4 times life size [S1]: one half cut open lying face up, the other half beside it, with part of the husk taken off to show the shell and its three sunken pores. Around the seed is a hard shell, and around that a thick fibrous husk [S17].

The coconut is adapted to be carried by sea currents [S17]; it floats and can be washed up on another shore.
detail.zh:
一个椰子，画成实物的约 0.4 倍 [S1]：一半剖开、切面朝上，另一半放在旁边，部分纤维层已去掉，露出硬壳和三个凹陷的孔。种子外面是坚硬的壳，壳外面是一层厚厚的纤维 [S17]。

椰子适应于随海流传播 [S17]：它能漂浮，被冲到别的岸边。

summary.en: Animals: hooks catch in fur and are carried off.
summary.zh: 动物：钩刺挂在毛上被带走。

detail.en:
A hooked fruit, drawn about 3 times life size and shaped like a cocklebur [S1]. Its many backward-curving hooks and the pair of beak-like points at its tip are based on real cocklebur specimens. Its hooks catch in the fur or feathers of animals brushing past, and the fruit drops off somewhere else.

In Singapore, beggar's tick (Bidens pilosa) has small one-seeded fruits with barbed hooks at the tip that stick to fur and feathers [S19].

It is the same idea as hook-and-loop fasteners on shoes.
detail.zh:
一个带钩的果实，样子像苍耳，画成实物的约 3 倍 [S1]。许多向后弯的钩和顶端那对像鸟嘴的突起，都参照了真实的苍耳标本。动物经过时，钩刺挂在它们的毛或羽毛上，果实在别处掉下来。

在新加坡，鬼针草（Bidens pilosa）的小果实只有一粒种子，顶端有带倒刺的钩，会粘在毛和羽毛上 [S19]。

鞋上的魔术贴用的也是同样的道理。

summary.en: Splitting: the drying pod bursts and flings seeds.
summary.zh: 弹裂：干燥的豆荚裂开，把种子弹出去。

detail.en:
A dry pod that splits open when ripe, drawn about 1.5 times life size [S1]. As it dries, the two halves pull apart and twist, flinging the seeds out.

Garden balsam's fruit bursts open at a touch and scatters its seeds; its Latin name, Impatiens, refers to this [S18].

The model draws a generic pod; in the chapter the two halves open on their own.
detail.zh:
一个成熟时会裂开的干荚，放大约 1.5 倍 [S1]。荚变干时，两半互相拉开、扭转，把种子弹出去。

凤仙花的果实一碰就裂开，把种子弹散；它的拉丁属名 Impatiens（「急躁」）就是由此而来 [S18]。

模型画的是一般的豆荚；在章节里，两半会自己打开。

summary.en: Animals: birds eat the fruit and pass the seeds.
summary.zh: 动物：鸟吃下果实，种子随粪便排出。

detail.en:
A ripe chilli cut lengthwise, drawn twice life size [S1]. Inside the hollow fruit, flat, pale seeds sit on a soft central column [S10].

Birds eat ripe chillies and pass the seeds out unharmed, ready to germinate. The hot substance in chillies, capsaicin, keeps many mammals away but does not put birds off [S15].

The number of seeds varies widely: from about 14 to 186 per fruit across 28 kinds of chilli in one study [S27].
detail.zh:
纵向剖开的成熟辣椒，放大 2 倍 [S1]。中空的果实里，扁平的浅色种子长在柔软的中轴上 [S10]。

鸟吃成熟的辣椒，种子随粪便排出时完好无损，还能发芽。辣椒里的辣味物质辣椒素让许多哺乳动物不吃它，却挡不住鸟 [S15]。

种子的数量差别很大：一项研究中，28 个辣椒品种每个果实里有约 14 到 186 粒 [S27]。

summary.en: Holds the soil and the roots.
summary.zh: 盛着土和根。

detail.en: A terracotta pot 18 cm high and 21 cm across [S1]. NParks suggests pots at least 15 cm deep for chilli [S13]. It is context for the model: in chapter 2 the front half is cut away to show the roots.
detail.zh: 陶土花盆，高 18 厘米、口径 21 厘米 [S1]。NParks 建议种辣椒的花盆至少深 15 厘米 [S13]。它是模型的场景件：第 2 章把前半边剖开，露出根。

summary.en: Holds water and mineral salts for the roots.
summary.zh: 为根保存水和矿物盐。

detail.en: Potting soil. It holds water and the mineral salts the roots take in. It becomes see-through in X-ray view.
detail.zh: 盆土，保存着水和根要吸收的矿物盐。透视模式下它会变成透明。

summary.en: Gives light for the fair test in chapter 4.
summary.zh: 为第 4 章的公平测试提供光。

detail.en: A lamp for the light fair test in chapter 4; outdoors the light comes from the Sun. Shown only in that chapter.
detail.zh: 第 4 章关于光的公平测试用的灯；在室外，光来自太阳。只在那一章出现。

summary.en: Keeps the second plant in the dark.
summary.zh: 让第二盆植物处在黑暗中。

detail.en: An upturned cardboard box over a second pot, for the light fair test in chapter 4. The front is left open in the model so the seedling inside can be seen.
detail.zh: 倒扣在第二盆上的纸箱，用于第 4 章关于光的公平测试。模型里纸箱前面是敞开的，好让人看到里面的幼苗。

summary.en: A young plant left without water.
summary.zh: 一株没浇水的幼株。

detail.en: A young chilli plant in a pot that has not been watered, with drooping leaves, for chapter 2. It is drawn smaller than the main plant and is not a matched pair for a fair test.
detail.zh: 第 2 章用的一盆没浇水的辣椒幼株，叶子垂了下来。它画得比主株小，不是公平测试里配对的一组。
